text: Every problem of the Kourovka Notebook (unsolved problems in group theory, eds. E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov), with its statement, its status and who solved it: people, or people with AI. Modelled on T. Tao's “AI contributions to Erdős problems”. Statements, answers and marks come from the Notebook's source (arXiv:1401.0300v50): since 2026 it marks a solution proposed by AI with ♯ until a mathematician confirms it, and with “AI solution confirmed by …” once checked. Beyond the Notebook: our notes, each with a primary source: solutions not yet in the Notebook, and which AI systems are behind the solutions. Last checked: 2026-11-26; updated weekly.
